PLAN A: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 9 PLAUSIBILITY 8 SIMPLICITY 7 TARGETFIT 5 SUITABILITY 8 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 7 — Replacing the handle with a multi-tool is mechanically odd for an external fix; "relationship" feels tacked on.
PLAN B: CAUSAL 6 CHRONOLOGY 5 PLAUSIBILITY 4 SIMPLICITY 6 TARGETFIT 2 SUITABILITY 5 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 4 — Characters explicitly stating their biological sex ("I am a man") to ask for help is unnatural and contradictory to social norms; target word usage is forced.

PLAN E: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 8 PLAUSIBILITY 8 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 7 SUITABILITY 8 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 8 — Solid domestic plot; "man/woman" intros are slightly stiff but functional for grammar drilling.
PLAN F: CAUSAL 7 CHRONOLOGY 9 PLAUSIBILITY 9 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 7 SUITABILITY 8 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 5 — Title says Monday, beats say Tuesday (contradiction); "man/woman" usage is awkward and unnatural.

blueprint.title: The Heavy Box Problem
blueprint.setting: A residential apartment building on a Saturday afternoon.
blueprint.problem: Xiao Hong needs to move a heavy box upstairs but cannot lift it alone.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Xiao Hong waits with a large box while looking for help.

beats.what: Xiao Hong stands with a large, heavy green box. She looks tired and unsure.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Li Ming walks into the lobby and sees the woman with the box.
beats.because: Li Ming is walking home and enters the building just as Xiao Hong is waiting there.

beats.what: Li Ming asks if the woman needs help with the box.
beats.because: He notices her struggle and recognizes a neighbor in need.

beats.what: Xiao Hong accepts the help and thanks him.
beats.because: She cannot move the box by herself.

beats.what: They arrive at Xiao Hong's apartment door. The box is safe.
beats.because: They lifted and carried the box together up the stairs.
beats.arrivedHow: 李明 and 小红 carry the box up the stairs together.

beats.what: They chat about how friendly neighbors are. Li Ming leaves.
beats.because: The task is finished, allowing time for conversation.

blueprint.resolution: Li Ming helps Xiao Hong move the box to her apartment, and they agree that being helpful neighbors is good.

blueprint.title: The Help
blueprint.setting: A residential apartment building, Saturday afternoon.
blueprint.problem: 李明 is trapped inside his apartment with a slipped lock and cannot get out for fresh air.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 李明 tries to open his door to leave, but the handle breaks off in his hand.

beats.what: 李明 tries to open the door to go for a walk, but the handle breaks. He is stuck inside.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: 李明 calls 小红, who is passing by in the hallway, asking for something.
beats.because: He is trapped and sees a neighbor nearby, realizing he requires assistance.
beats.where: The Hallway Outside 李明's Door

beats.what: 小红 looks at the door and says it is locked; she cannot open it without a key.
beats.because: 李明 asked for help, so she assesses the situation physically.
beats.where: The Hallway Outside 李明's Door

beats.what: A 男人 walks by. 小红 asks him if he can help because he looks strong.
beats.because: 小红 realizes she lacks the physical strength or skill, so she seeks another adult.
beats.where: The Hallway Outside 李明's Door

beats.what: The 女人 who lives next door appears and says she has a multi-tool in her bag.
beats.because: The 男人 does not stop, changing the context of who can provide aid; 小红 shifts focus to the other neighbor.
beats.where: The Hallway Outside 李明's Door

beats.what: The 女人 fixes the lock. 李明 opens the door. They discuss how friends help each other.
beats.because: The 女人 had the tool and the skill, resolving the physical barrier.
beats.where: The Hallway Outside 李明's Door

blueprint.resolution: The door is opened by the neighbor using a tool, and the characters acknowledge the value of neighborly support.

targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To state his inability to solve the problem alone

targetPlan.speaker: 小红

targetPlan.speaker: 小红

targetPlan.why: The problem is solved through external aid.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明

targetPlan.intent: To express gratitude for the action taken

targetPlan.why: The characters reflect on the social bond between them.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.intent: To contextualize the interaction as a positive social event

blueprint.title: The Heavy Box and the New Neighbor
blueprint.setting: A residential apartment building hallway, weekday afternoon
blueprint.problem: 李明 is struggling to move a heavy box without assistance.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 李明 drops his package after his hands slip.

beats.what: 李明 is holding a large, heavy box. His hands are sweating and his grip is slipping. He is struggling to walk.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: The box slips from 李明's hands and falls heavily on the floor. 李明 cannot lift it alone. He realizes he requires help.
beats.because: 李明 tries to carry the box, but it is too heavy and he loses his grip.

beats.what: A young woman opens her door nearby. She sees the man on the floor with the broken box. She asks if he is okay.
beats.because: The loud thump of the box falling attracts the attention of the neighbor in the next doorway.

beats.what: The woman introduces herself as 小红. 李明 explains he cannot lift the box. 小红 offers to assist him.
beats.because: The woman observes the man's difficulty and decides to intervene.

beats.what: They lift the box together and carry it into 李明's home. They put it down safely.
beats.because: Since 小红 offered to help, they physically move the object to its destination.

beats.what: 李明 thanks 小红. She says that good neighbors should help each other. They are now friends.
beats.because: The physical task is complete, allowing for social closure and relationship building.

blueprint.resolution: The box is moved safely, and 李明 and 小红 establish a friendly neighborly relationship.
